description: This PHP class defines the entity 'SelectedCompositeDisplayField' for use with Doctrine ORM. It maps to the database table 'ohrm_selected_composite_display_field' and models relationships with 'CompositeDisplayField' and 'Report' entities. The class includes properties with ORM annotations, getter, and setter methods to manage the entity's data.

classes.name: SelectedCompositeDisplayField
classes.description: Doctrine ORM entity representing a selected composite display field associated with a report.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the selected composite display field.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the selected composite display field.
